author: Hamza
description:
What happens when a company trusted with billions of dollars suddenly collapses, leaving customers wondering whether they will ever see their money again? Crypto’s Billion-Dollar Disappearance is a two-part investigative podcast exploring one of the most shocking financial scandals in modern cryptocurrency history: the collapse of FTX and the downfall of its founder, Sam Bankman-Fried.

Once celebrated as a brilliant entrepreneur, Bankman-Fried became one of the most recognizable faces in the cryptocurrency industry. FTX attracted investors, celebrity endorsements, and customers around the world. Its success appeared to represent the future of digital finance. But beneath the company's impressive image, serious financial problems were developing.

In Episode One, The Empire That Vanished Overnight, we examine FTX's rapid rise, the public image that helped build trust, and the events that triggered its dramatic collapse in November 2022.

In Episode Two, Follow the Money: The Billion-Dollar Mystery, we explore the customer funds at the center of the scandal, the investigations that followed, and the legal consequences that changed the cryptocurrency industry.

Through a gripping narrative of ambition, misplaced trust, financial misconduct, and accountability, this series asks an essential question: when money exists largely as digital records, how can ordinary people know whom to trust?

title: Essence of an Artist by Loren Ellis
author: Momentum Media Advertising
description: Essence of an Artist follows Loren Ellis through grief, depression and a five-year project she insists was never her idea, one begun in 2016 as her mother passed and finished in 2020. Through her art, her poetry and her life story, you'll watch a dream nearly abandoned become a finished book and documentary. By the final episode, you'll see how a creative calling survives loss, and how yours can too.  You'll leave with a clear sense of how to carry a creative project from first spark to finish line. Loren's philosophy shows you why to ask "why" instead of "how" you create, why a mistake can be a miracle, and why process matters more than product. You'll learn her six-stage photographic painting process, including the darkroom discipline of "painting with light," and her "creative bubbles" editing technique. You'll also hear her advice on staying focused, trusting your intuition, using AI "to format the first coat; but not to replace," and turning your art into service through collaboration over competition.  This season is for listeners and readers who carry an unfinished dream: the novel in a drawer, the half-built canvas, the idea you keep setting down. It's for anyone who has felt lost in the middle of the lake and wondered whether moving forward "like a turtle" counts as progress. (It does.) If you're an artist, a writer, a grieving child or simply someone curious about creative persistence, Loren's story will make you feel seen, and ready to begin again.

title: Formula 1: History and Legends
author: baradellopublishing@proton.me
description:
Your heart rate quickens; in the distance, you hear the deep, muffled rumble of a V12 engine coming to life... then, silence. Welcome: I will be your guide on this journey to the very limits of physics. This is not your typical sports report about who crossed the finish line first last Sunday. Formula 1 is much more than a sport—it is an open-air technological laboratory, a saga defined by extreme engineering, visceral rivalries, legendary triumphs, and dramatic moments that have shaped history. Over the course of these ten episodes, I will take you straight into the cockpit, behind the scenes in the pit garages, and into the heart of the paddock’s most closely guarded secrets. From the humble, dusty beginnings of the 1950s to the hybrid single-seaters that look like spaceships...
Episode Index

Episode 1: The Origins - From the Ashes of War to the Circuits of Glory (The first GP at
Silverstone in 1950).
Episode 2: The Drake and the Red - The Birth of an Immortal Myth (Enzo Ferrari's life,
philosophy, and obsession).
Episode 3: The English Revolution - When the Engine Ends Up... Behind! (Colin
Chapman's and Cooper's intuition).
Episode 4: The Golden Age and Risk - Heroes Without Fear (The 1970s amid extreme
speeds, danger, and Jackie Stewart's battle).
Episode 5: Fire and Ice - The Legend of Hunt and Lauda (The 1976 duel and the dramatic
Nürburgring crash).
Episode 6: The Era of the Titans - Prost, Senna, and Total War (The psychological and
sporting rivalry between Alain Prost and Ayrton Senna).
Episode 7: The Black Saturday of Imola - The Turning Point of Modern Safety (The tragic
1994 weekend and the revolution for driver protection).
Episode 8: The Kaiser and the Red Domination - Michael Schumacher and the Ferrari
Legend (Team reconstruction and 5 consecutive world titles).
Episode 9: F1 in the Hybrid Era - Silent Power and Generational Records (Turbo-hybrid
engines from 2014 and Sir Lewis Hamilton's record era).
Episode 10: The Future of the Circus - Global Entertainment and New Frontiers (Netflix's
media boom, Drive to Survive, and new generations).
Episode 11 (Special): The Triumph of the Tricolore - Kimi Antonelli and the Italy of Talents
(Celebrating Andrea Kimi Antonelli's victory and Italy as a cradle of racing talents).

description:
When Dr. Andrew Larkin, a leading scientist in the field of reanimation, successfully brings the dead back to life, he inadvertently opens a Pandora's box of ethical dilemmas and unforeseen consequences. 'Recalled to Life' dives deep into the complexities of a world where death no longer holds the finality it once did. As families reunite with long-lost loved ones, the emotional fallout becomes more than just joy; it spirals into chaos, revealing the darker side of humanity’s desire to conquer mortality.

Amidst the excitement of groundbreaking technology, Larkin grapples with the haunting repercussions of his work. Why do we want to bring back those who have died? What does it mean for our understanding of life and death? Each reanimated individual carries with them the weight of unresolved issues, creating a web of conflict that entangles everyone involved.

Listeners will embark on a thought-provoking journey as they explore themes of identity, the ethics of science, and the essence of human connection. "A Farewell to Arms" dives deep into the heart of human connection, exploring how love can bloom in the darkest of times while grappling with the inevitable shadows of loss and despair.

As Frederic navigates the harrowing landscape of conflict, he confronts not just the physical dangers of the battlefield but also the emotional turmoil that war inflicts on the soul. Will his relationship with Catherine withstand the relentless pressures of a world at war? How does the fight for survival influence their bond? Hemingway masterfully captures the essence of longing, fear, and the fleeting nature of happiness, drawing listeners into an intimate journey that probes the depths of love and the harshness of reality.

This gripping audiobook invites you to experience the poignant moments between Frederic and Catherine, highlighting the stark contrasts between love and war, hope and hopelessness. title: Articulated: The Boston Ballet Podcast
author: Boston Ballet
description: In the studio, we articulate through movement. Here, we articulate through words. Dedicated to Mikko25, join us for conversations on dance with the people at the heart of it all.

title: Missent: The Story of a Letter (A Romantic Quest for Connection)
author: Pansy
description:
When Sarah Stafford discovers an old postcard wedged between the pages of a dusty book at her hotel, she uncovers more than just a forgotten message. This postcard, written years ago, becomes a catalyst for an unexpected journey that pulls her from the depths of loneliness into a world filled with intrigue and possibility. As she races against time to track down the postcard's intended recipient and the mysterious author, Sarah faces her own emotional barriers. Each new clue she uncovers reveals not just the story behind the postcard, but also opens her heart to connections she never thought possible.

Set against the backdrop of the holiday season, "Missent: The Story of a Letter" weaves a tale of romance, hope, and second chances. Sarah's quest is more than just a simple investigation; it challenges her to confront her feelings of isolation and longing. Will she find the answers she seeks in time for Christmas, or will the search lead her to a deeper understanding of herself?

Join Sarah on this heartfelt journey filled with unexpected twists and a sprinkle of holiday magic. Her exploration of love, loss, and the power of a simple letter will resonate with anyone who believes in the magic of connection. Dive into this enchanting tale and discover how a single postcard can change everything.

title: From the Cheap Seats
author: Cheap Seats Sports
description:
Welcome to From The Cheap Seats — where sports, opinions, and the great outdoors come together.
Baseball is our bread and butter, with plenty of MLB talk, hot takes, debates, and breakdowns of the biggest stories around the game. We’ll mix in some football, cover the biggest trending stories across the sports world, and throw in some outdoorsman conversations along the way.
We’re fans talking about the things we love, keeping it real, having a little fun, and never being afraid to share an opinion. Just top-tier takes from the nosebleeds.
Welcome to The Cheap Seats.

title: By Lawyers Legal Issues Podcast
author: By Lawyers
description:
Deep technical dives into Australian and New Zealand law and practice, with the practitioners who know it best.


The By Lawyers Legal Issues Podcast is for lawyers and law students who love getting into the detail. In each episode, Brad Watts, Managing Editor of By Lawyers Australia and New Zealand, sits down with an experienced practitioner to unpack a specific area of law: what the rules require, where practitioners trip up, and how to get it right in practice. Guests include barristers, solicitors, legal tech experts and many of the authors behind the By Lawyers guides and precedents.


Brad brings more than 30 years experience in private and government legal practice as a partner, director, consultant and solicitor advocate.
 
‘I’m a self-confessed law nerd and dedicated general practitioner,’ he says. ‘If they introduce specialist accreditation as a generalist, I'll be the first to apply! 


I hope our listeners  find these chats as helpful and enjoyable as I do.’


Practical insight from the people who write the guides. Follow the show so you don't miss an episode.

title: Love Obsessed The Podcast
author: Stacy Palmerio
description: Local boutique owner, and Philly area native Stacy Palmerio talks all things love, relationships, fashion & travel with her co-host Miles Munz.

title: Can We Say This Out Loud?
author: Christa Spear
description:
We spend our lives navigating expectations and following unwritten rules without always questioning why they exist or whether they still make sense. 
On Can We Say This Out Loud?, Christa Spear shares personal stories, daily observations, and fresh perspectives on work, leadership, motherhood, emotions, and societal norms that shape our everyday experiences. With curiosity, humor, and a willingness to challenge traditional thinking, Christa explores the things we're all thinking but don't always feel comfortable saying.
Because chances are, if you're thinking it, someone else is too.

title: Ahem, Excuse Me
author: Ahem
description: A comedy podcast that helps you understand and question medical bills, insurance Explanation of Benefits (EOB) statements and billing errors. Marge knows the rules. The Bill would rather you didn't. The Phone Tree is going through something. Every episode gives you one rule or number with its source, one phone call to make, and one sentence you can send to ask a billing office to explain itself. Topics: itemized bills, EOBs, duplicate charges, denied claims and appeals. General information, not advice about your specific bill. All voices are computer-generated, including a clone of the host's voice. Marge and the other characters are fictional. The rules they quote are real, and sources are in every episode.

title: 90's Kids Podcast
author: Duane Steinel
description:
If you grew up in the 1990s, you know it wasn't just another decade—it was the bridge between the analog world and the digital age.

Every week, we revisit the music, movies, television, video games, toys, trends, and unforgettable pop culture moments that shaped an entire generation. But this isn't just another nostalgia podcast.

We'll also explore the bigger moments that defined us—from the first time we heard about 9/11, to life before smartphones, dial-up internet, MuchMusic, mixtapes, Blockbuster, and everything in between. We'll compare how we grew up to how the world works today, and ask how those experiences continue to shape who we are.

Some episodes will settle the great debates—best albums, greatest TV shows, or the toys we begged our parents for. Others will take a deeper look at the events, technology, and cultural shifts that changed our lives forever.

Whether you were rocking a Discman, waiting for your favorite song to come on the radio, or spending Friday nights at the video store, this podcast is your chance to relive the decade—and make sense of everything that's happened since.

Because being a 90s kid wasn't just about growing up in a great decade. It was about growing up during one of the biggest cultural transformations in history.

title: Guided The Podcast
author: Guided The Podcast
description:
At Guided, we believe that every career journey is unique and worth sharing. Our podcast is dedicated to exploring the diverse paths people take in their professional lives, highlighting the triumphs, challenges, and unexpected turns that shape their careers.

Our mission is to inspire and inform our listeners by showcasing authentic african stories through our conversations with guests from a diversity of professional backgrounds.

Our aim is to be a resource for students and professionals seeking to explore the myriad of possibilities and fluidity of the workspace.
Whether you’re just starting your career, contemplating a change, or seeking motivation to push forward, Guided offers insights and perspectives that can guide and encourage you on your own journey.

Guided is hosted by two friends, Jacinta Adrigwe and Gilda Madeira, medical doctors with a passion for career development.

Having navigated the academic environment and subsequently the workspace with minimal, and at times no, career guidance, we often questioned if our experiences and the trajectory of our careers would have been different had we had mentorship and insights into the experiences of other’s that walked a similar path.

We wished for a platform like this during the critical phases of our professional lives and are excited to provide this for anyone that may benefit from it.

title: Men Into Space (Adventures of Ed McCauley)
author: Murray Leinster
description:
Ed McCauley never dreamed his fascination with rockets would lead him into the vast, uncharted territories of outer space. In 'Men Into Space,' join Ed on a gripping journey as humanity transitions from the rudimentary rockets of today to pioneering spacecraft that will unlock the secrets of the cosmos. This captivating audiobook chronicles the thrilling evolution of space exploration, revealing the trials, triumphs, and technological innovations that make it all possible.

As Ed navigates the challenges of building the Space Platform and embarking on historic missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond, he faces not only the physical dangers of space travel but also ethical dilemmas and the weight of human ambition. With each new adventure, listeners will grapple with the central question: what does it truly mean to reach for the stars?

Through Ed's eyes, experience the wonder and excitement of space exploration, where each launch is a leap into the unknown, and every landing brings new mysteries to unravel. 'Men Into Space' isn't just a tale of scientific advancement; it’s a reflection on humanity's relentless pursuit of knowledge and the spirit of adventure that drives us to explore the universe. Get ready to ignite your imagination and explore the frontiers of human ingenuity in this must-listen audiobook.

title: John McKean Sports Mindset Academy Podcast
author: Sports Mindset Academy
description:
Join John McKean on the Sports Mindset Academy podcast for honest conversations with athletes, coaches and mindset experts about the mental side of sport. Explore pressure, self-doubt, confidence and setbacks, with practical mindset tools and insights into sports hypnosis to help you perform at your best.
Mental performance and hypnosis for athletes. Compete with confidence—win, lose or draw.

title: The Queueline Chronicles
author: Queueline Chronicles
description:
Every great ride starts with a line, and every line has a story. Queueline Chronicles is the podcast about the people, the parks, and the moments that happen between the entrance and the ride.
Hosted by Dan, each episode brings you park news, trip reports, guest interviews. . Whether you’re a seasoned park-goer planning your next visit or just love hearing about the magic (and chaos) of theme park life, you’ll find something to enjoy.
Expect plenty of laughs, insider tips, and a few tales you won’t believe

title: Understanding Israel with Dwayna Litz  Podcast
author: understandingisrael
description:
Dwayna Litz is not a pastor--never has been, never will be and has never wanted to be--but she is a Christian like any other who likes to know what she believes about God and why she believes it. She also hates a lie about Jesus and hates to see people made in God's image--of any race or tribe all over the world--abused in the name of God through quoting Bible verses with wrong interpretations.

When Trump's war with Iran began in 2026, some things were not making sense she was hearing from other Christians in America. She went to her pastor, Jon Cardwell, with questions about correct Bible interpretations concerning Israel, as she saw Protestant Christians justifying genocide, which she knew went against John 3:16.

Some spoke as if genocide was "God's will," which she knew was not. Why? It goes against what the New Testament teaches. So, she took the verses being used to justify this to her pastor. The answers to her questions from her pastor became an article series he wrote, now posted on his Substack at www.jonjcardwell.com  called "Understanding Israel from Scripture."

As she was reading his answers and learning how correct Bible interpretation never contradicts Jesus, she had the idea for this podcast to share those same answers with others. For more about Dwayna Litz, go to the web site for her Christian nonprofit and read about the outreach she began at Venice Beach, CA, with the only Christian table on a boardwalk surrounded by psychics. It was a unique "table outreach" based on logic and reason and what the Bible teaches about answers to life's questions, which spread internationally. See photos and read more about it at www.LightingTheWayWorldwide.org .

For more on Dwayna's music and books, go to www.DwaynaLitz.com .

Also, join her on her Facebook page at "Lighting The Way Worldwide" in her international outreach of journalism from a Christian perspective that exposes unbiblical "Christian Nationalism" in America. It looks at current, world events in the lens of a healthy hatred for hypocrisy in the "Christian Right" that is so often, sadly, wrong.

Against racism, Dwayna Litz says, "It takes just as much grace to save a Moslem as it takes to save me. The ground is level at the foot of the cross for everyone in God's love. There is no race supreme over any other, thanks to all that Jesus has done for us. I am no better than the biggest sinner on earth, apart from God's mercy on my life."

Favorite quotes:

"There is nothing holy about the Holy Land, and it will not be holy until Jesus comes again." --J. Vernon McGee

"It is laughable that God has favorites in His family." --Charles Spurgeon

"I believe in Christianity as I believe the sun has risen; not only because I see it, but because I see everything else."   

-C. S. Lewis.

Favorite Bible verses:

"God is love." 1 John 4:8

"Have nothing to do with the unfruitful deeds of darkness; instead, even expose them." Ephesians 5:11

"But may it never be that I should boast except in the cross..." Galatians 6:14

"God is no respecter of persons." Acts 10:34

This podcast aims to show that God does not show favoritism, and all people are made in the image of God and deserving of respect as human beings.

Of course, there is no such word as "Zionism" in the Bible.

Dwayna Litz has many Jewish friends and loves all people. This is not aimed to be misunderstood as "antiSemetic" but to just take an honest look at what the Bible teaches.

Join Dwayna Litz as she will also be defining "Israel" and looking at reasons why the political state of Israel is not the same as the Israel of the Old Testament--based on world history, current events, how this political state is governed by Kabbalah and Freemasonry, and a look at what the Bible teaches about what it means to be "chosen by God" in the first place.

(Caveat: Dwayna's nonprofit 501c3 is not affiliated with any political party, never has taken funds from the government or any political party and never will. The message of God's love cannot be bought with money and is far greater and purer than "dirty politics.")

title: Landline with Mary Mahoney
author: Mary Mahoney
description:
Landline is the podcast where pop culture gets some context. Each episode, historian Mary Mahoney calls up guests to connect today’s celebrity culture, TV, movie, music, and online trends to the histories that make them make sense. It’s like a group text for people who love footnotes, or the answer to the question, “Why can’t history feel more like US Weekly?”


You can find the Patreon here: https://www.patreon.com/cw/MaryMahoney

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Jada Renee runs the table while analyst Zeus Lawson breaks down the games and Kingston O'Neal drops the takes nobody else will touch.
NBA, NFL and MLB with a betting edge, from The Sports Nus.

We will cover all things of the world. What’s rights and what smells fishy. Never sugar coating just giving it right to u..

title: The Optimisation Playbook with SKR
author: SKR
description: TOP discusses the best ways to build, optimise and use bootstrapping to develop and launch websites and apps.

title: Von Wolfie Lost in the Dark
author: Von Wolfie
description:
Step into the shadows of Lost in the Dark, where the unexplained lurks, the ordinary becomes terrifying, and not everything that disappears is ever truly gone.
Explore horror stories filled with chilling mysteries, eerie encounters, supernatural forces, and the darkness hiding just beyond the familiar. From unsettling small-town secrets to things that should never have been awakened, each story takes you somewhere you may not want to return.
Turn down the lights, put on your headphones, and prepare to get lost.
Some stories are better left untold.

title: Forum Europe and Forum Global Podcast Series
author: Forum Europe and Forum Global
description: Forum Europe and Forum Global are where people and policy meet. Since 1989, we have connected leaders from government industry and civil society through influential European and global policy events. This podcast series captures the key insights, discussions, and perspectives from these forums, featuring voices of stakeholders shaping today’s policy landscape. Subscribe to follow the conversations influencing Europe and the world.

title: A Network of Crime (America's Greatest Detective)
author: Nicholas Carter
description:
Nick Carter, America’s greatest detective, faces a chilling double murder that will test his brilliance and resolve. When a man is found stabbed and another shot dead, the lines between victim and villain blur. Who is truly guilty in this tangled web of crime? As Nick delves deeper into the investigation, he uncovers a network of deceit, betrayal, and unexpected alliances that could unravel everything he believes about justice.

In "A Network of Crime," listeners will join Nick on a gripping journey through the underbelly of crime, where every clue leads to more questions than answers. This audiobook not only immerses you in a thrilling mystery but also explores themes of morality, the nature of evil, and the complexities of human relationships.

With each twist and turn, you’ll feel the stakes rise as Nick races against time to solve the case before the real perpetrator strikes again. Can he separate the innocent from the guilty, or will he fall victim to the very forces he seeks to expose?

Join Nick Carter on this captivating audio adventure, where danger lurks at every corner, and trust can be the deadliest weapon of all. Perfect for fans of crime fiction, this story will keep you on the edge of your seat, craving the next clue and desperate to uncover the truth.

title: Audience of One Podcast
author: IN TUNE Performing Arts
description: a podcast for artists, by artists exploring how our art, our performance, our creativity, and our stories can point beyond the spotlight and reveal the heart of Jesus.

title: Voice of experience
author: Papczynski
description:
Every story has a voice. Every experience has a lesson.
Voice of Experience is a story-sharing podcast that creates a safe space for real-life experiences, untold stories, personal struggles, life lessons and moments that shape who we become.
From love and relationships to family expectations, academic pressure, career struggles, personal growth, disappointments, triumphs and rediscovering oneself, we bring authentic human experiences to the microphone.
Here, every voice matters, every story deserves to be heard, and every experience has something to teach.

title: BEYOND THE SHIFT | An Operation Meditate Podcast Series
author: Operation Meditate
description:
A podcast dedicated to the wellbeing of healthcare workers, first responders and everyone working within the healthcare system. Through honest conversations, shared experiences and practical tools, we explore the realities of working in healthcare and how we can better support our wellbeing, both on and off the shift. We recognise that wellbeing is shaped by more than individual choices. Workplace culture, organisational pressures, leadership and psychological safety all matter.
Welcome to Beyond the Shift. 💚

title: Personal Growth Made Easy
author: Emma
description: Personal Growth Made Easy, a podcast dedicated to self-improvement, personal development, motivation, and building a better version of yourself. Explore practical strategies for developing positive habits, improving confidence, managing time, overcoming challenges, and achieving personal goals. Discover how small daily changes can lead to meaningful improvements in your mindset, productivity, relationships, and lifestyle. Whether you want to become more confident, stay motivated, or create a more successful future, this podcast offers simple ideas and inspiration to help you grow every day.

title: The Everything Podcast 2.0
author: Hannah Beecher
description: Everything from Baseball to horses

title: The Inimitable Jeeves (Bertie's Dilemmas)
author: P. G. Wodehouse
description: Bertie Wooster's life takes a chaotic turn when he finds himself entangled in a web of romantic mishaps and family pressures, all thanks to his relentless Aunt Agatha. As Bertie stumbles from one absurd predicament to another, it becomes painfully clear that he is utterly hopeless at navigating the complexities of love and friendship. Enter Jeeves, his brilliant and unflappable valet, who possesses an uncanny ability to untangle the messes Bertie creates. In this delightful romp through British high society, listeners will laugh along as Bertie grapples with misguided engagements, ill-fated romances, and the ever-looming threat of Aunt Agatha's disapproval. Each chapter unveils new adventures, including mistaken identities, eccentric suitors, and ludicrous schemes that only Wodehouse could imagine. With clever dialogue and a sharp wit, 'The Inimitable Jeeves' showcases the hilarity of life’s unpredictability and the value of a good friend. Discover how Jeeves concocts ingenious solutions to Bertie's blunders while keeping his own secrets close to the vest. This audiobook will keep you guessing—what ingenious plan will Jeeves devise next? Join Bertie and Jeeves on their uproarious journeys, where every twist and turn leaves you eager for more. Perfect for fans of humor and classic literature, this tale is a timeless reminder that sometimes, the most outlandish problems need an equally outrageous solution.

title: Investor Return
author: Investor Return
description:
Investor Return is your upbeat, easy‑listening guide to building wealth with clarity, confidence, and zero jargon. Whether you’re 18 or 80, just starting out or rebuilding from scratch, this podcast breaks down the financial strategies used by the world’s smartest investors and richest people —and translates them into simple, practical steps anyone can follow.
Hosted by a team of relatable money experts, each episode dives into the real habits behind financial success.Investor Return delivers the world’s most practical money tips and ideas for you to make steps towards financial freedom.

title: Just Some Takes
author: JJ
description: I talk about baseball, basketball, and football. I provide my opinions on these sports and my analysis.

title: Speak with Confidence
author: Jason
description: Speak with Confidence, a podcast dedicated to helping you learn new languages and improve your communication skills. Explore practical language-learning techniques, useful vocabulary, everyday conversations, pronunciation, grammar, and speaking tips. Discover how to overcome the fear of speaking, build confidence, and communicate naturally in different languages. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced learner, each episode brings helpful ideas and simple strategies to make language learning easier and more enjoyable. Learn new words, improve your speaking skills, and open the door to new cultures and opportunities with Speak with Confidence.

title: Better Every Day - Improvement Stories with the Northern Trust
author: Northern Health and Social Care Trust
description: A podcast exploring improvement culture in healthcare and beyond. How some changes we make can lead to improvements, and some do not. Exploring the mindset and the challenges behind making Improvements by hearing stories from the people involved, about what sparked their journey of improvement, what have they tried, if it has made a difference or not and most importantly what have they learnt.

title: All That Prevails
author: Sierra Tamirin Smith
description: All That Prevails is a podcast named in honor of my late father, Vincent, whose name means “to prevail.” It will explore the things that remain through life’s journey. Always recorded outdoors, usually while walking my dog, Castle, each episode offers reflections on the things that keep us going: hope.

title: Permission to Deviate
author: Laura
description:
Welcome to Permission to Deviate — a raw, unfiltered, occasionally inappropriate podcast about breaking free from expectations and discovering who the hell you really are. We're talking midlife reinvention, entrepreneurship, creativity, financial freedom, spirituality, healing, and unapologetic self-love. No sugarcoating, no pretending we've got it all figured out, and definitely a few F-bombs. Because life is too damn short to live by someone else's rules.
Your life. Your rules. Permission to deviate granted.

title: Unchosen: The Raw Truth
author: Shay
description:
I'm a woman in my late 50s. Never married. No children. Unemployed. Trying to make sense of a life that looks nothing like I imagined.
How did I get here? That's a long story.
Unchosen: The Raw Truth is where I share that story, including the decisions I've made, the things I never saw coming, and the realities I'm facing today. Some of it will be painful. Some of it might be funny. All of it will be the raw truth.
My hope is that sharing my story will help me make sense of it all and perhaps help someone listening feel a little less alone. Maybe this will be therapeutic for both of us.

title: SIGHT UNSEEN
author: Elyssa Booth
description: This is more than my story it’s about all of us who have had to start again. From my boldest move selling everything I owned and moving across the country sight unseen to building a new life with nothing but faith, this podcast explores resilience, growth, and transformation. Join me as we talk about life, healing, and creating a better tomorrow together.

title: Georgia Girl Gabs
author: Kari
description:
Hey y’all! Welcome to Georgia Girl Gabs, where a Southern girl with big dreams, lots to say, and a whole lot of random thoughts chats about life, love, laughter, and everything in between!
From funny stories and relationships to growing up in the South, everyday chaos, and those moments that make you say, “You just can’t make this stuff up!”
Some days we’ll laugh, some days we’ll get a little serious, and other days… well, there’s no telling where the conversation might go! Around here, no topic is off-limits!
Grab your coffee, sweet tea (or your beverage of choice), get comfy, and let’s gab like old friends! 💗🍑

title: In Conversation
author: Law Institute of Victoria
description:
The legal profession is key to helping shape a fair, informed and democratic society.
 
The In Conversation podcast from the Law Institute of Victoria features in-depth discussions between leading voices in the profession on the issues shaping law and society. Episodes explore big-picture topics, including access to justice, the rule of law, legal leadership and the future of the profession. Browse all episodes below or find us wherever you listen to podcasts.

title: Wokcast from the Wokingham Borough Lib Dems
author: Wokingham Borough Lib Dems
description: Digging into local issues and what we can do to shape an even brighter future for Wokingham Borough.

title: Faithful + Flourishing
author: Kirby
description: With this podcast, I hope to encourage women in their walk with God. Let's learn how to love God deeper and live closer to his will by reading His word, sharing testimonies and discussing life experiences so that we can be the women, mothers, sisters, daughters and wives that God intended us to be. Each week, we’ll talk about real-life struggles, biblical wisdom, and practical ways to walk with God daily.

title: Friendship Generations
author: Rebecca Barbier
description:
When we were younger, friendships naturally connected us to people of all ages. We looked up to our friends’ parents for guidance, learned from older siblings and cousins, and spent countless hours playing with younger children in our neighborhoods. Those relationships helped shape who we became. We gained wisdom from those with more life experience and rediscovered joy, curiosity, and perspective through those who were younger. Somewhere along the way, many of us narrowed our circles to people who look like us, live like us, and are the same age as us. But some of life's richest friendships are the ones that bridge generations.

Intergenerational friendships offer something unique. They challenge our assumptions, broaden our perspectives, and remind us that every stage of life has something valuable to teach. Whether it is the reassurance of experience, the confidence to take risks, or the optimism of youth, these relationships help us continue growing long after we reach adulthood.

Join three friends who met at work and discovered that age was not a barrier, but a gift. Coming from different generations, backgrounds, and life experiences, Rebecca, Sonja, and Amanda found an unexpected connection that grew into a deep and lasting friendship. Rebecca’s experience and mentorship helps open doors and provide perspective during pivotal moments. Sonja’s confidence, humor, and infectious energy remind everyone around her to embrace life more fully and not take every challenge so seriously. Amanda’s youthful enthusiasm and sunny outlook brings fresh ideas, optimism, and a renewed sense of possibility. Together their humor draws a crowd.

What began as a workplace connection evolved into a support system through career changes, personal challenges, celebrations, and life milestones. Together, we discovered that while we may approach the same situations differently because of the decades that shaped us, those differences became our greatest strength.

Come join the conversation as we share stories, lessons, laughter, and the unique value of friendships that span generations. Along the way, other friends with similar cross-generational relationships will join the discussion, exploring how meaningful connections across age groups enrich our lives, strengthen our communities, and remind us that friendship has no age limit.

title: Comedy Conversations
author: kenneth
description: Enjoy hilarious interviews, funny questions, unexpected answers, celebrity-style conversations, and amusing stories from everyday life. Each episode brings laughter, entertaining discussions, and lighthearted moments with different personalities and perspectives. From funny personal experiences to unusual opinions and crazy conversation topics, Comedy Conversations is all about making people smile. Whether you love comedy, interviews, or simply need a good laugh, join us for conversations that make entertainment unforgettable.

title: Ian Yan
author: Ian Yan
description:
Turns out you can be the worst one out there — and still score.
Flag on the Play is a first-person audio documentary about being completely out of your depth, and staying anyway. One month after picking up flag football, Ian Yan found himself at the Asia Pacific championship in Sydney: the only amateur team, forced into the men's division, down to four players by the final. Cinematic, funny and honest, it's a story for anyone who has ever been the worst one in the room.

title: The Power of Giving
author: Morgan
description: The Power of Giving, a podcast dedicated to exploring kindness, charity, community service, and the positive impact of helping others. Discover inspiring stories of nonprofit organizations, volunteers, donors, and people working together to make the world a better place. From supporting education and healthcare to fighting poverty, protecting the environment, and helping communities in need, every episode highlights the importance of compassion and social responsibility. Learn how small acts of kindness can create meaningful change and how individuals and organizations can contribute to a brighter future. Join us to celebrate generosity, inspire action, and discover the true power of giving.

title: Middle Aged Nonsense
author: Taller Than Moses
description:
The uniquely brilliant mini podcast from Taller Than Moses.

Expect random aches, unnecessary opinions, questionable advice, sharp observations, and plenty of musical nonsense—all packed into short, gloriously chaotic episodes.

Because getting older is inevitable but finding the extraordinary in the mundane can be wonderfully entertaining.

Join the short, sharp, and musically ridiculous middle aged revolution. New episodes every Monday.

description:
Violent Crap Podcast where you can listen to interesting stories from all over the globe. Natural disasters, plane crashes, sinking boats, machine accidents, True Crime, all true, short stories to listen to while you walk run, drive, or fall asleep.

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/violent-crap--7539544/support.

title: Strange Skies
author: Steve Cote
description:
Strange Skies & the Unexplained. A show from Steve Cote: ex-paranormal investigator, longtime sky-watcher, and the guy who actually reads the files.
Hosted by Alex Sloane. And on Friday nights, Jack Sterling takes you After Dark — legends, cryptids, and ghost stories. Plus special radio dramas in the tradition of the golden age of radio.
Got a story? Seen something in the sky? Write to us: strangeskiespodcast@gmail.com — your story could be our next episode.
Website: https://strangeskiespodcast.com
Every episode, two things. First, the UFO wire: what's really in the Pentagon's declassified files, minus the hype and the headlines. Second, the paranormal: haunted places, strange legends, and spooky stories from around the world, retold right here.
Short episodes. Real sources. No filler. Strange Skies is a Steve Cote production.
Music: Hollow Shrine by SNOWMINNSNOW. After Dark: Classic Horror 1 by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) and The Dark Forest by Vivek Abhishek (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3agbTAU68jc).

title: Built for the Mission
author: BITSnBYTES.io
description:
Built for the Mission is a BITSnBYTES.io podcast hosted by Scott Macri, exploring the people, technology, and decisions behind mission-critical systems.
Through conversations with software engineers, cybersecurity professionals, AI experts, government and industry leaders, operators, and policy experts, we explore what it takes to build, secure, deploy, and govern technology when the mission matters.
Real experience, practical lessons, and meaningful conversations about software, cybersecurity, AI, federal technology, and mission systems.

title: Smart Management
author: Joseph
description: Welcome to Smart Management, a podcast dedicated to exploring the essential skills of effective management, leadership, productivity, teamwork, and business success. Discover practical management strategies, improve your decision-making skills, learn how to manage time effectively, and understand what makes a successful leader. Whether you are a student, business owner, team leader, or working professional, Smart Management brings you useful ideas and simple techniques to help you become more organized, confident, and productive. Learn smarter ways to manage people, solve problems, achieve goals, and grow professionally.

title: The Aperitivo Hour
author: The Aperitivo Hour Podcast
description:
The Aperitivo Hour is where life in Sicily meets honest conversation, good wine, and plenty of opinions.
Join Dara and Priscilla, two North American women who have made Sicily their home, as they talk about everything from Italian culture, food, and relationships to friendship, motherhood, dating, and the unexpected realities of living abroad.
Think of it as catching up with your girlfriends over aperitivo. Funny stories, different perspectives, unfiltered conversations, and a little bit of la dolce vita.
Pour yourself a glass and pull up a chair. There's always a lot to talk about.

title: The Shame of Motley (A Noble's Swashbuckling Journey)
author: Rafael Sabatini
description:
Lazzaro Biancamonte, once a nobleman, now wears the motley of a court jester, forced into this perilous role under the tyrannical thumb of Giovanni Sforza. In "The Shame of Motley," Rafael Sabatini weaves a tale of cunning and courage as Lazzaro navigates the treacherous waters of 15th-century Italy. His heart belongs to the beautiful Madonna Paola De Santafiore, but their love faces relentless obstacles, from deadly political intrigues to the shadowy machinations of Cesare Borgia, who has his own ambitions for power.

As Lazzaro dons the jester's cap, he discovers that humor can be a weapon as sharp as any sword. Each jest hides a strategy, each laugh masks a deeper truth, and in a world where betrayal lurks behind every corner, survival demands both wit and bravery. With every twist and turn, listeners will be drawn into Lazzaro's fight for love and freedom, wondering whether he can reclaim his noble birthright or if he will remain forever trapped in a role designed to mock him.

This audiobook pulses with adventure, romance, and the relentless quest for identity amid chaos. Will Lazzaro and Paola's love endure the trials ahead? Join them as they embark on a thrilling journey of heart and honor, where every choice could lead to ruin or redemption.

A show where you hear compelling stories

title: THE FINAL ENCORE : A celebrity death mystery series
author: Eric lee
description:
🎙️ THE WAIT IS OVER! THE FINAL ENCORE IS HERE!

First, I want to sincerely apologize for the wait. Thank you to everyone who has been patient and continued to support Eric UN-muted Podcast. Your support means everything! 🖤

THE FINAL ENCORE | An Eric UN-muted Podcast Series

Their lives made history. Their deaths left questions.

The Final Encore is an investigative storytelling series from Eric UN-muted Podcast examining the shocking deaths of legendary celebrities, cultural icons, and influential figures whose final moments left the world searching for answers.

From Hollywood legends to music superstars, we revisit the lives, final days, controversial circumstances, official investigations, and conspiracy theories surrounding some of the most unforgettable figures in history.

Each episode goes beyond the headlines, exploring documented facts, disputed details, unanswered questions, and theories that continue to spark worldwide conversations. We examine what we know, what remains unexplained, and what the public is still questioning.

But we don’t want this conversation to end with us.

Listen, question, connect the dots, and form your own conclusions. Share your thoughts, theories, and perspectives with us. Because every story deserves to be examined, and every voice deserves to be heard.

Follow and subscribe to Eric UN-muted Podcast so you never miss an episode. Share the series, leave a review, and join the conversation.

THE FINAL ENCORE — Where the spotlight fades, but the questions remain.

Presented by Eric UN-muted Podcast.

title: THAT RICK WILSON
author: Rick Wilson
description:
Welcome to That Rick Wilson.
Real talk, honest conversations, and everything in between.
I’m Rick Wilson, and this is where we explore the things that make us human. Love, relationships, fatherhood, heartbreak, personal growth, and the conversations we don’t always have.
Some days we’ll laugh. Some days we’ll dig into life’s uncomfortable truths. And sometimes, we’ll simply slow down with guided meditations and moments of reflection.
No pretending. No perfect people. Just real life, real stories, and a little perspective along the way.

description: Learn about the best Welcome to the Fiji Travel Guide podcast—your ultimate resource for everything you need to know about planning the perfect trip to Fiji! Whether you're dreaming of lounging on pristine beaches, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters, exploring vibrant coral reefs, or immersing yourself in Fijian culture, this podcast has you covered. Discover insider tips on the best resorts and accommodations, exciting adventure activities, and must-see attractions across Fiji's beautiful islands. We'll also share advice on travel planning, packing, and navigating local customs in Fiji.

Hosted by Hope, this show blends real testimony with honest reflection on trusting God through uncertainty, hardship, and quiet seasons. Each episode pairs scripture with story — no easy answers, just honest faith. For anyone navigating career, family, and calling, seeking encouragement, spiritual growth, and hope that’s tested, not performed. New episodes biweekly

author: Michael House
description: We all have random thoughts from time to time, sometimes they are really funny, sometimes they make you scratch your head, sometimes serious, and other times spiritual. I am going to share some of my thoughts on many different topics on this Podcast. Be ready for anything.

title: Off the Review: Interviews by Nikki
author: Two Girls, One Review Co-Host: Nikki
description:
🎙️ Off the Review: Interviews by Nikki is where real stories meet honest conversation. A spin-off of Two Girls, One Review, this series takes a closer look at the people behind the work, creatives, leaders, and visionaries from all fields. 
Host Nikki brings thoughtful questions and genuine curiosity to every episode, uncovering what drives her guests, how they navigate challenges, and what success really means to them. Pull up a seat, it’s time to go Off the Review.

title: New Thought Literature Podcast
author: Travis Ahern
description: For a hundred years, people were trained to work like machines. Now machines are learning to think like people, and most people are scared. They don't have to be. Entrepreneur Travis Ahern, who came from nothing and built 19 companies that generate more than $200 million a year, sits down with builders and friends to talk about mindset, self-talk, business, health and the New Thought ideas that turn fear of AI into hope, purpose and the drive to create. Free books, guides and the Sunday letter at newthoughtliterature.com.

description: XRP the Standard is a daily, feel-good XRP news show for the XRP Army. Every morning: adoption, partnerships, institutional moves, legal and regulatory wins, XRP Ledger developments and ETF flows, plus the wider crypto market, in about four minutes. Not financial advice.

title: We Never Had It So Good: The Burg and Peth Podcast
author: Burg & Peth
description:
Two friends. Two opinions. One shared love of films, television and popular culture.
Welcome to We Never Had It So Good, where Burg and Peth get together to revisit the films and TV shows they’ve loved, the ones they’ve forgotten, and the ones they still can’t agree on.
From childhood memories and classic movies to television favourites, music, celebrities and the changing world of popular culture, nothing is off limits.
It’s about friendship, nostalgia, opinions and plenty of laughs.
Two old friends, countless memories and always something to talk about.
Because looking back — we never had it so good!

title: Living Better With Lupus | Fatigue, Inflammation, Brain Fog, Gut Health, Stress and Emotional Health
author: Amy Crawford, NBC-HWC | Certified Functional Medicine Health and AIP Coach
description: You can leave a lupus appointment with a plan & still wonder: How do I get my life back? I'm Amy Crawford, a board-certified health coach, certified in functional medicine & AIP. I live with lupus & my lupus nephritis has been in remission for over a decade. Here, science meets real life. We'll talk lupus fatigue, flares, inflammation, brain fog, gut health, stress & the emotional side of chronic illness. You'll learn practical ways to work with your body & doctors, ask better questions, advocate for yourself & make room for the life you want. Your diagnosis isn't the end of the conversation.

title: Two Torches To The Wind - Conversations From The Tiki Lounge
author: Two Torches To The Wind
description: A tiki talk show with two guys having a drink, talking tiki, and riffing on each other. The conversation stays loose and lively — we’re not debating if something is tiki, we’re asking the fun part: why is it tiki to you? So, hop into the lagoon, pour yourself a drink, and join the escape.

title: Sobriety With Sean
author: SEAN WILLERS
description:
Sobriety with Sean explores alcohol, addiction and sobriety: the highs and lows of drinking, why we drink, why some of us stop, and how we build a life without alcohol.


Hosted by Sean Willers, founder of Willers Coaching. Sean began drinking at 14 and struggled with cocaine addiction for eight years.


Now more than three years sober, he brings people from different backgrounds together to share their experiences with alcohol, from enjoyment and social connection to the consequences and difficult choices.


Drawing on his own experience with alcohol and drugs, Sean and his guests explore drinking culture, identity and what shapes our relationship with alcohol.


They discuss what helps people change, what hasn’t worked for them, and why some people have no interest in sobriety.


Whether you drink, are questioning your relationship with alcohol or have already stopped, there’s a place for you in the conversation.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Pray the Rosary with Campion College Australia
author: Campion College
description:
Join the students of Campion College Australia in praying the Holy Rosary.


We warmly invite you to pray alongside our students as we contemplate the Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious and Luminous Mysteries of the Rosary, reflecting on the life of Jesus Christ through the loving intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary.


Our prayers are offered for the intentions of the students, faculty, staff, families, benefactors and friends of Campion College, and for all those who join us in prayer, wherever they may be.


Whether you are praying at home, on your daily commute or simply seeking a quiet moment with Our Lady, we hope these recordings bring you peace, comfort and a deeper connection to Christ.


Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.

title: Not A Sports Podcast
author: Not A Sports Podcast
description:
It's a sports podcast. Just not the kind you're used to.
Welcome to Not A Sports Podcast, hosted by Kennedy Thornton, where sports, pop culture, and everything in between are always on the table.
Think unfiltered girl talk about the sports we love, the people who play them, and everything happening on and off the track and ice. Because sports are about more than just the game, and there's room for everyone in the conversation.
New episodes every Tuesday & Friday

title: Gone Fishing (Exploring Ethical Dilemmas)
author: James H. Schmitz
description:
When a simple fishing trip turns into a deep dive into the ethics of scientific discovery, two friends find themselves caught in a web of unintended consequences. In 'Gone Fishing,' James H. Schmitz explores the fine line between innovation and morality as they uncover a groundbreaking technology that could change humanity forever. But with power comes responsibility, and the duo soon realizes that their excitement may lead to dire repercussions for the world at large.

As they navigate the murky waters of their findings, they confront tough questions: What happens when intelligence outpaces our ethics? Can we control the very innovations we create? With each twist and turn, listeners will be drawn into a thought-provoking narrative that challenges the boundaries of science and humanity's role in its own destiny.

Packed with suspense and rich themes, 'Gone Fishing' is not just a tale about fishing; it’s an exploration of how choices ripple through time and impact lives. Join this gripping journey as the characters wrestle with their discovery and its potential to reshape the future. Will they become stewards of progress or architects of chaos? Discover the answer as you immerse yourself in this riveting science fiction narrative.

title: The Funny Thing Is
author: Nicole Burch
description:
The Funny Thing Is Podcast is where comedian, Nicole Burch, interviews friends, comedians, and creatives as they share three things: a life changing event, the “medicine” that helped them heal, and the funniest thing they learned along the way. Listen as they share their heartache and triumph and partake in all the belly laughs throughout. 


So…what is that craziest thing that happened to you? Now, tell me the funniest thing about it.



Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Novus Gnosis
author: Scien-Sha
description:
Novus Gnosis is a serialized spoken-word podcast hosted by Scien-Sha and synthetic co-host Vāc. Grounded in the Unified BioCosmic Hypothesis (UBH), the series synthesizes non-equilibrium thermodynamics, complexity science, depth psychology, and ancient gnosis to confront civilization's existential bottleneck: the Great Filter.

Moving beyond reductive materialism and techno-feudalism, Novus Gnosis provides an open-source operating system for surviving civilization’s adolescence.

title: Resilience Brilliance
author: Jena Taylor
description:
Resilience Brilliance™ Podcast
Real stories. Real science. Real resilience.
Hosted by Jena Taylor — brain injury survivor, resilience strategist, and marketing maverick — Resilience Brilliance™ is where courage meets comeback. Each episode shines a light on the many faces of resilience — from everyday people rising from life’s toughest moments to leading experts in neuroplasticity, psychology, trauma recovery, divorce, abuse, and well-being who help us understand how we rise. Some guests share personal stories of heartbreak, healing, and hope. 
Others bring the science, tools, and insight behind emotional strength and transformation. And some beautifully blend both.This isn’t just another “feel good” show. It’s a movement — a reminder that resilience isn’t about bouncing back… it’s about rising differently.
Tune in for laughter, honesty, science, and soul. Because no matter what life throws your way, you have the brilliance to rise again.
👉 Be Real. Be Resilient. Reclaim your life.™

title: The Bible
author: Loren Fuller
description:
I'm an old guy who likes the Bible - certainly no Bible scholar.  This show is just me reading the Bible.  No commentary.  I AM NOT A PROFESSIONAL PODCASTER.

The artwork for the show is very special to me.  The gentleman to the left is my wife's grandfather.  He was probably the most humble, godly man I've ever known.  He loved the Bible.  This picture was taken later in his life. His vision was failing and he could no longer read.  The lady to the right is my wonderful wife.  She is reading it to him. My recollection of the moment was that it brought a tear to his eye.  I know it did mine.  I'm getting choked up a little bit typing this.

Join us as we talk with marketers, founders and business owners about their stories - how they found their feet, the challenges they encountered along the way, and their perspectives on some of today's biggest marketing topics.

title: The Garden of Self-Strength
author: Lisandra Samuels, BS, CWC
description: Welcome to The Garden of Self-Strength Podcast! I am Lisandra Samuels, a mental wellness coach, MSW student, and military spouse. This podcast is a dedicated space for women navigating major life transitions, mindset shifts, faith, and personal growth. Tune in for honest conversations, practical encouragement, and actionable strategies to help you navigate resilience and thrive in every season.

title: The Great Airport Mystery (Hardy Boys' Adventure)
author: Franklin W. Dixon
description:
When Frank and Joe Hardy stumble upon a suspicious package at the airport, they plunge headfirst into a web of intrigue that will test their detective skills like never before. In "The Great Airport Mystery," the iconic teenage sleuths unravel a plot that intertwines smuggling, high-stakes theft, and a race against time. As they chase leads that take them from bustling terminals to shadowy hangars, the brothers discover that not everything is as it seems. With danger lurking around every corner, their quest for the truth becomes a thrilling adventure filled with unexpected twists.

Listeners will join Frank and Joe as they decode cryptic messages and confront shadowy figures, all while balancing school life and their commitment to justice. This audiobook captures the essence of youthful ambition and the drive to uncover the truth, making it an exciting listen for adventurers of all ages. Do the Hardys have what it takes to crack this case before it's too late? Find out in a story that combines clever detective work with edge-of-your-seat action. Perfect for fans of mystery and adventure, "The Great Airport Mystery" invites listeners to engage their own sleuthing skills and immerse themselves in a world where every clue counts and danger is just a step away.

title: Enjoy Pathways
author: Enjoy Education
description:
Enjoy Pathways is a podcast dedicated to exploring the diverse educational journeys that children and young people take when the traditional school model no longer feels aligned with their needs, ambitions or family life. 


Through considered conversations with educators, clinicians, parents and sector specialists, we examine topics such as homeschooling, private tuition, school transitions, wellbeing and broader lifestyle choices that influence a child's development. 


This podcast series also explores the experiences of globally mobile and entrepreneurial families seeking alternative approaches. Including world schooling and flexible, travel-led models of learning. 


At it's core, Enjoy Pathways is about understanding and emphasizing that there is no single route through childhood and adolescence, and with the right guidance, families can design an educational pathway that supports both wellbeing and long-term success.

description:
"Did not our hearts burn within us while he talked to us on the road, while he opened to us the Scriptures?" (Luke 24:32, ESV)
Burn Our Hearts walks through today's most-watched sermons: the preacher's key points, where Jesus shows up in the message, and one thing to do this week.

Burn Our Hearts uses AI host voices (Mina and Eli). The sermons are real, the preachers are real, and every episode is reviewed by an ordained pastor. We're here to send you back to the Bible and your local church.

title: Dr. Flavio Explains Hypnosis & Inner Mastery
author: Dr. Flavio
description:
Clear, honest conversations about hypnosis, the mind, and what it takes to recover when stress, burnout, heartbreak, or a health challenge is taking too much of you.

Your host, Flávio Souza-Campos, MD, PhD, has practiced clinical hypnosis since 1996 and conducted more than 44,000 individual sessions. His training spans medicine, biomedical engineering, and philosophy, and he has been through serious personal difficulty himself. In plain language, he explains why understanding a problem is not the same as changing it, and what actually helps.

In this podcast:
• Clinical hypnosis and hypnotherapy: what hypnosis is, what it is not, and when it helps
• Stress, burnout, and breakdown in high-functioning professionals
• Heartbreak, betrayal, and rebuilding after loss
• Relationships, connection, and couples
• The subconscious mind, habits, and learned emotional responses
• Living with a health condition: sleep problems, IBS, menopause, and cancer-related distress
• Philosophy, meaning, and inner mastery
Plus conversations with hypnotists, coaches, therapists, and authors.

Two ways to work with Dr. Flávio
For comprehensive private coaching for physicians, surgeons, and attorneys: innermasteryworks.com
For one specific medical concern (hypnotherapy for IBS, sleep, menopause, and cancer-related distress): drflavio.com
Articles: innermasteryworks.com/blog

This podcast is educational and is not medical or psychological treatment advice.

title: 1834 TALKS
author: 1834 Foundation
description:
1834 Talks is a podcast produced by Operation Black Vote Canada (OBVC) and the 1834 Foundation. Named after the year the Slavery Abolition Act was enacted in Canada, the 1834 Foundation, with the support of OBVC, is committed to empowering Canadian Black youth through programs such as the 1834 Fellowship, 1834 Global, and 1834 Debates. These programs are aimed at educating and nurturing Black youth development in civic leadership and public policy.
 
Tune in to our podcast for authentic conversations featuring 1834 alumni engaging with prominent figures from Canadian politics and public policy, along with fellow alumni, providing valuable insights and perspectives.

title: Built From Within
author: Built For This
description:
Built From Within is a podcast about the work that happens beneath the surface.

Hosted by IFBB Pro and Certified Personal Trainer Stephanie Walti, Built From Within explores the mindset, identity, habits, and experiences that shape who we become, both inside and outside of fitness.

Because knowing what you should do is one thing. Actually understanding yourself well enough to change is another.

Each episode explores the deeper side of growth: how we build confidence, develop discipline, navigate failure, change our patterns, take ownership of our lives, and become the person capable of creating the life we want.

Through conversations with coaches, athletes, mentors, experts, and people with stories worth hearing, Stephanie digs beyond the surface-level advice of “just be more disciplined” or “think positive” and explores the tools, experiences, and perspectives that make real change possible.

Built For This is the belief.
Built From Within is how we build it.

title: Lead The Middle with Scott Chest
author: Scott Chest
description:
Leadership gets tested in the middle, where expectations meet the people doing the work. Scott Chest brings nearly 30 years in mining, construction and safety to straight conversations about ego, accountability, trust and leading a crew. Practical lessons for foremen, superintendents, managers and anyone responsible for people. 
Control your ego. Influence everything.
 Learn more at LeadTheMiddle.com.

title: R&M Podcast
author: Keyon and Paul
description: Welcome to the R&M Podcast, hosted by Keyon and Paul! We bring you funny interviews, hilarious stories, real conversations, and unfiltered discussions about politics, current events, sports, and everything happening in today's world. Expect laughs, hot takes, and conversations you won't forget!

title: A Second Home (Clara Bell Translation)
author: Honoré de Balzac
description:
When young lawyer Félix de Vandenesse marries his childhood friend, he envisions a life filled with love and partnership. Instead, he faces an unexpected reality: the woman he once adored now embodies a rigid and narrow-minded piety that stifles their connection. As Félix grapples with his disillusionment, he finds himself torn between duty and desire, navigating the complexities of faith, friendship, and societal expectations.

In "A Second Home," Honoré de Balzac explores the intricate dynamics of marriage and the often-hidden fractures that can emerge between partners. This novella dives deep into the themes of compatibility, class, and the shifting tides of personal belief. With every turn of the page, listeners will uncover the subtle yet profound conflicts that arise from mismatched values and aspirations. Can love endure when the foundation begins to crumble?

As Félix confronts the stark reality of his wife’s transformation, he embarks on a journey that challenges his understanding of virtue and happiness. How far will he go to reclaim the spark of their youthful bond? This audiobook invites listeners to reflect on the delicate balance between personal beliefs and the shared life of a couple. Join Félix in a tale that resonates through time, exposing the timeless struggle between heart and obligation, and discover whether a second chance truly exists in a relationship clouded by fundamental differences.

title: Inside Music with Adam Weissler
author: Inside Music with Adam Weissler
description:
Emmy award winning host Adam Weissler chats with today’s top music makers, tomorrow’s cutting edge talent and legendary artists that deserve celebration. In-depth + candid conversations about their art, craft, the joy of making music and much more! 
Go INSIDE MUSIC with Adam Weissler.

A new episode comes out every day.

Three guys discussing the stories we love. From anime and manga to movies, TV, and everything in between, we're here to debate, laugh, and share our unfiltered opinions on all things entertainment.

Welcome to the Worst Take Podcast.

title: The Inner Closet

description: The Inner Closet is a sanctuary for older gay men still living in the closet and navigating the journey toward living authentically. Through reflective stories about late coming out, love, aging, sex, and the expectations we carried for decades, each episode offers the honesty and compassion needed to build a life that feels like your own.

title: The Prince and the Dragons (A Tale of Adventure and Mischief)
author: Tudor Jenks
description:
When young Prince Barnaby drops a toy wooden elephant into the shimmering waters of the castle moat, he unwittingly hooks a world of mischief and adventure. What starts as a simple fishing quest spirals into a whirlwind of encounters with the enigmatic Count Bricabrac, the clever Duchess Darningneedle, and a scheming witch with plans of her own. As Barnaby navigates this fantastical realm, he discovers a hidden family of dragons that hold the key to restoring harmony in his kingdom.

Join Barnaby on a quest filled with unexpected twists, humorous challenges, and magical creatures. Each character he meets adds depth to his journey, revealing the importance of friendship, bravery, and clever thinking in the face of adversity. What secrets do the dragons guard? How will Barnaby's decisions shape his future and the fate of his castle?

Tudor Jenks weaves a delightful tale that captures the imagination of listeners young and old. With its engaging narrative and vibrant characters, "The Prince and the Dragons" invites you to explore the magic that lies beneath the surface of everyday life, all while posing the whimsically intriguing question: What happens when a toy turns into the bait for destiny? Discover the enchanting surprises that await in this action-packed adventure!

title: She Rises Anyway
author: Stephanie Williams

title: A Perfectly Imperfect Union: Conversations with Everyday Americans
author: Michael OBrien
description:
The headlines say we’re hopelessly divided. Our neighbors tell a different story.  A Perfectly Imperfect Union is a podcast of reflection, resilience, and conversations with everyday Americans: people with different perspectives, backgrounds, and life experiences who choose like-heartedness over like-mindedness. This isn’t a political debate show; the world has enough of those. It’s real people sharing what connects us, what’s broken, and how we repair it together.  
In a time of polarization, these conversations remind us that common ground is closer than we think. The show is inspired by my 2022 bike ride across America and by kintsugi, the Japanese art of mending broken pottery with gold. Instead of hiding America’s scars, we look at them honestly, as the places where healing, connection, and trust can begin.  The conversation began in 2026 as a special series for America’s 250th birthday on the Whole Again podcast, with 79 everyday people from all 50 states and D.C. 
Now it continues for the weary hopefulists: people who haven’t given up on us, but who are tired of the noise and division.  If you’re looking for conversations about bridging divides, finding common ground, civil dialogue, kindness, community, and rebuilding trust, pull up a chair.  
Michael O’Brien, executive coach, mindfulness teacher, and author, hosts. New episodes every Sunday.

In "Mystery Mile," Margery Allingham weaves a tale of suspense where danger lurks at every corner. As Campion digs deeper, he discovers a web of intrigue that connects Lobbett's past to a series of unexpected twists. Listeners will be drawn into a world where clever dialogue meets unexpected alliances, and every clue brings the stakes higher.

This audiobook invites you to join Campion on a journey filled with thrilling escapades, witty banter, and a touch of romance. As he races against time to uncover the truth, you’ll find yourself questioning who to trust and what secrets lie beneath the surface. With a mix of humor and heart-pounding suspense, Allingham crafts a narrative that keeps you guessing until the very last moment.

Perfect for fans of classic crime fiction, "Mystery Mile" combines sharp characterizations with a captivating plot that explores the nuances of justice and morality. Whether exploring issues like rising property taxes, commercial development along the Highway 400 corridor, infrastructure priorities like the Orbit GO station, or summarizing council meetings, Innisfil Up Front breaks down local decision-making into digestible, engaging dialogue. The series serves as a civic resource for community members seeking to understand how municipal choices impact their daily lives, local tax dollars, and neighborhood growth. And residents are encouraged to support local news reporting.


Through episode recaps, feature highlights, and forward-looking previews of incoming council sessions, Innisfil Up Front brings local democracy directly to listeners across the municipality.

title: Strange Love: A Novel of Abnormal Passion (Passion and Identity)
author: Georges Eekhoud
description:
Count Henry Kehlmark grapples with a forbidden love that defies societal norms in Georges Eekhoud's gripping novel, *Strange Love: A Novel of Abnormal Passion*. Set against the backdrop of a late 19th-century Europe that’s both progressive and repressive, Henry's journey unfolds as he confronts his own desires in a world that demands conformity. The stakes are high as he navigates the complexities of his identity, battling the inner turmoil of self-acceptance while facing the brutal reality of societal rejection.

This audiobook delves deep into the emotional landscape of love and longing, exploring the delicate balance between personal integrity and societal expectations. As Henry’s relationships with the women in his life—his nurturing mother and devoted friends—intersect with his growing feelings for another man, listeners will experience the raw intensity of his struggle.

Eekhoud’s vivid prose invites listeners to reflect on themes of isolation, fear, and the courage it takes to embrace one's truth. Each chapter illuminates the profound cost of honesty in a world teeming with judgment, making this tale as resonant today as it was over a century ago. What price will Henry pay for love? Find out in this poignant exploration of passion, identity, and the quest for acceptance that will linger long after the final words.
